![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The `forbiddenRemoteDependenciesAbsent` check currently only verifies a subset of the boundary flags. To ensure strict adherence to the 'checked-in artifacts only' constraint and prevent any untracked local or remote dependencies from passing silently, consider expanding this check to include all other boundary flags such as `untracked_local_screenshot_dependency`, `handoff_file_dependency`, `remote_disposable_supabase_write_performed`, and `runtime_api_integration_performed`.

```suggestion
  const forbiddenRemoteDependenciesAbsent =
    boundaryValue.checked_in_artifacts_only === true &&
    boundaryValue.untracked_local_screenshot_dependency === false &&
    boundaryValue.handoff_file_dependency === false &&
    boundaryValue.remote_supabase_query_required === false &&
    boundaryValue.remote_supabase_mutation_performed === false &&
    boundaryValue.production_rag_reindex_performed === false &&
    boundaryValue.vector_store_mutation_performed === false &&
    boundaryValue.remote_disposable_supabase_write_performed === false &&
    boundaryValue.runtime_api_integration_performed === false &&
    boundaryValue.frontend_ui_integration_performed === false;
```

Fixed in a64437d0c. `forbiddenRemoteDependenciesAbsent` now asserts all ten runtime_dependency_boundary flags: checked_in_artifacts_only true, and untracked_local_screenshot_dependency / handoff_file_dependency / remote_supabase_query_required / remote_supabase_mutation_performed / production_rag_reindex_performed / vector_store_mutation_performed / remote_disposable_supabase_write_performed / runtime_api_integration_performed / frontend_ui_integration_performed all false.
Fixed in a64437d0c. `countBy` now iterates `arrayFrom(rows)` so a non-array (null/undefined) input yields an empty count map instead of throwing.

Fixed in a64437d0c. Added a shared `optionsFrom` guard; `rootFromOptions` and `generatedAtFromOptions` now normalize null/non-object inputs before reading `.root`/`.generatedAt`, falling back to the script defaults.

Fixed in a64437d0c. `validatePostAttemptReviewPayloadAll3530` now normalizes its argument via `optionsFrom` and fails closed on null/malformed input. Added a regression test covering undefined/null/{}/null-fields/malformed inputs, asserting validator_status `fail`, the `total_...not_3530` + `missing_...not_zero` errors, and a failed `all_3530_payload_rows_represented` check.
